name: Parties
description: Who originates a loan. The lender, the appraiser, and the title company are instances of one organization. The borrower is an instance of person. This domain is the vocabulary, not the lender.

entities.name: Organization
entities.description: A firm in the origination. Three instances, one entity.

entities.name: Person
entities.description: A person. The borrower and a co-borrower are instances, not two kinds of person.

instances.name: Jo
instances.description: Co-borrows with Sam on the refinance.

relationships.name: borrows from
relationships.description: A person borrows from an organization. The edge has no terms of its own. Terms live on the application.
